svg.title: Figure 1 · Every parameter block
svg.desc: Every block of every parameter file with its value count, the readers that name it and unread values
svg.text: 6 files, 208 values. Each cell: values set and the readers that name them; a red count is values no reader names (4: CL-01: safety.beacon, CL-02: safety.beacon, CL-03:

Readers: B = build_concepts.py · C = cl05.py · W = cl05_web.py · T = cl05_terrain.py · K = blender_walk.py · D = drawings.py · R = readme.py. A key named in a reader is likely read; a key named in none is certainly unread.
Generated by tools/figures/params_readme.py from cad/params and the code that reads it. Every value is a placeholder for review and alignment, not design data.

g.text: Terms: CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout)
